payload.core_mechanism_summary: Uses combinatorial pre-processing and binomial coefficients (Lucas theorem) to compute final number in O(n log MOD) time, not backtracking.
payload.rationale: Solution reduces array and applies nCr summation; it's a combinatorial math approach, not search. Forced into complete_search family due to candidate_families constraint, so 'search_backtracking' is chosen as least unfitting.
